items.note: Fixed — signing (Sign now, or Insert saved signature) now sets the Statement date to that day, in the form and on the printed and PDF copies, and tells you it changed it. The old date was a separate field that signing never touched. You can still edit it under Statement of compliance.

Done — the Archived filter now shows every archived message, however old (it used to show only those among the 50 most recent). The count tells you when it’s complete and why anything is missing. The All view still loads the latest 50.
